about_the_game:
Rebuild a lost world with the power of capybaras.

The entire world has fallen. Ruins are all that remain, scattered across a lonely and unforgiving land. But hope is not lost. Two brave capybaras, Capyshan and Capymay, have survived the collapse. With nothing but each other and a dream of rebuilding, they set out to restore their once-thriving home.

Capyvarias is a clicker colony game set in a soft post-apocalyptic world. Start with just two capybaras and grow your colony one step at a time. Gather resources, assign tasks, expand your shelter, and unlock strange new technologies left behind by the old world.

Every capybara counts. The more you have, the more your colony can grow. But survival will not be easy. The world is harsh, and rebuilding takes patience, clever choices, and a whole lot of capylove.

Features

  • Cute clicker gameplay with light strategy

  • Adorable capybara characters (with hats)

  • A cozy post-apocalyptic world filled with mystery

  • Build and grow your colony from ruins to space age

  • Survival and progress require attention, planning, and persistence

Can your capybara colony rise from the ashes and reach the stars?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Help Capyshan and Capymay rebuild the Capyvarias empire. Everything is gone. Only these two brave capybaras remain, determined to raise their community from the ashes. Can you click your way to survival, growth, and a future among the stars?
